recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-15675 source follow-up is needed unless the work group wants a separate editorial cleanup of the sentence independent of this already-applied clarification.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core profiling clarification. The issue reported that the original identical profile sets definition was tautological because it said resources conforming to A also conform to B and then restated the contrapositive; it suggested defining identical sets as all resources conforming to A also conforming to B and all resources conforming to B also conforming to A.
initial_application: The Supporting Multiple Profiles section was originally added for FHIR-6085 in svn revision 6360. FHIR-15675 was then applied in svn revision 14321, represented by git commit bc42cabc7375d8121772cde649a612fc38b52f35, which changed source/profiling.html from the tautological sentence to explicit set-equality wording. Current blame still points the identical sets line to that FHIR-15675 commit.
additional_context: Current source/profiling.html is the active profiling narrative page for the related section and defines identical sets as the same conforming-resource set, with the same non-conforming complement. Jira wording searches found only FHIR-15675 and the originating FHIR-6085 context, while quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community discussion or later work-group decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source no longer contains the tautological wording reported by FHIR-15675 and conveys the accepted symmetric set relationship; the remaining redundancy is not a necessary semantic correction for this issue.
